slides.name: queue-worker
slides.title: Who retries a failed job?
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 450"><style>@keyframes transfer {to {transform: translateX(320px)}} .signal {animation: transfer 2s ease forwards}</style><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#161b22"/><rect class="signal" x="80" y="200" width="200" height="40" fill="#79c0ff"/><text x="80" y="140" fill="#e6edf3" font-size="32">Queue worker</text><text x="400" y="300" fill="#e6edf3" font-size="28">Record result</text></svg>
slides.static_svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 450"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#161b22"/><rect x="400" y="200" width="200" height="40" fill="#79c0ff"/><text x="80" y="140" fill="#e6edf3" font-size="32">Queue worker</text><text x="400" y="300" fill="#e6edf3" font-size="28">Record result</text></svg>
slides.description: Queue worker receives a job and records the result. The retry owner must be specified.
qualifications: Proposed design; recovery behavior has not been demonstrated.
slides.notes: Retain queue worker, request-driven service, and scheduled batch job as peer alternatives.

slides.name: request-service
slides.title: What happens when a request ends?
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 450"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#161b22"/><text x="60" y="140" fill="#e6edf3" font-size="32">Request-driven service</text><text x="400" y="300" fill="#e6edf3" font-size="28">Return response</text><circle cx="150" cy="240" r="18" fill="#79c0ff"><animate attributeName="cx" from="150" to="480" dur="2s" fill="freeze"/></circle></svg>
slides.description: Request-driven service returns a response. Background completion needs an explicit design.
qualifications: Ending a request does not establish a background completion guarantee.
slides.notes: Compare the lifetime of the request with the lifetime of the job.

slides.name: scheduled-batch
slides.title: When is the next batch processed?
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 450"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#161b22"/><text x="60" y="140" fill="#e6edf3" font-size="32">Scheduled batch job</text><text x="400" y="300" fill="#e6edf3" font-size="28">Process pending jobs</text></svg>
slides.static_svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 450"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#161b22"/><text x="60" y="140" fill="#e6edf3" font-size="32">Scheduled batch job</text><text x="400" y="300" fill="#e6edf3" font-size="28">Process pending jobs</text></svg>
slides.description: Scheduled batch job processes pending work on its schedule. Schedule delay is part of the comparison.
qualifications: No measured completion time is supplied.
slides.notes: Compare scheduling and retry ownership without changing the alternative's name.
